execute if score @s health matches ..10 run effect give @s minecraft:regeneration 5 1

execute if score @s health matches 11.. run tellraw @s {"text":"You look fine.","color":"gray"}

meta.notes: A function is a list of commands without the leading slash; lines starting with # are comments. This one stores your health in a scoreboard and uses execute if score to branch. @s is whoever runs the function. The editor checks every line as you type.
